notes: Cars and drift tracks point at Racing, but the author was explicit that nobody races and nothing is scored, and Racing's own boundary says a driving game with no lap and no finish is Simulation's Vehicle Sim. A shared rural dirt yard everyone free-drives in is world-open — one common world with no personal plot — and it is a single continuous surface, so the route is a plain P0. I kept the preset's path-road-vehicle bent to wide dirt tracks and skid pads sized for a drifting car, and dropped resource-shared since nothing is extracted here. Deciding without a user: cars simply spawn in the yard, so no garage interior and no P3; the drift cars and the off-road rally cars the author clarified are vehicle content rather than layout; and the yard stays flat open dirt because no hills or jumps were asked for.
